review_basis: Hand-traced in the running canvas app's Linear tool (manual mode, scale confirmed from the plan's own '1/4" = 1'-0"' note) via a Playwright-driven browser session against the rendered PDF, following the run centerlines visually and reading segment sizes directly off the drawn duct-size text before committing each segment. Confirmed against a screenshot of the live LF/size-breakdown widget after each commit, and against the whole-sheet render (mcp/scripts/graph-render.mjs --all) studied beforehand to identify the full extent of every supply-duct trunk on the sheet.
scope: GATE 1 asks for Bessemer M101's supply mains. This sheet draws two independent horizontal supply-duct trunks, one per first-floor heat-pump unit (HP-1), each running from its heat pump's boot connection out to its farthest labeled diffuser/register, with an explicit rectangular-duct size change partway along. Both are in scope as the sheet's 'supply mains' (plural, matching GATE 1's own wording). Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for this golden: the round vertical branch/riser drops off each trunk (6"ø and 8"ø stubs down to the SR-1/SR-2 registers), the 4" EA exhaust duct riser (near keynote 2, EF-1), and the short 14x3½ stub serving Bedroom 2 (a branch off a vertical riser, not a horizontal main). General note 1 on the sheet ('UNIT 103 MECHANICAL LAYOUT IS TYPICAL OF ALL UNITS EXCEPT UNIT 102') is why Units 101/104 show no drawn ductwork on this sheet -- there is nothing there to trace.
